CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED STATEMENT OF OPERATIONS AND OTHER DATA
(Dollar and share amounts in thousands, except per share data)

Note: The company said that due to the acquisition of IVAC in November 1996, the actual 1997 consolidated ALARIS Medical operating results are not comparable to those of prior periods. The unaudited pro forma condensed consolidated statement of operations and other data presented above has been presented as if the merger occurred January 1, 1996 to demonstrate changes in the comparable actual 1997 data.

The pro forma operating data excludes nonrecurring merger, purchase accounting and restructuring charges related to the acquisition of IVAC. Additionally, the actual historical IVAC data includes the operating results of River Medical, an IVAC subsidiary divested prior to the merger, which results are excluded from the pro forma data presented herein.
The company said it expects continued revenue growth on a pro forma basis in the second quarter.
